name: Sorbitan monocaprylate
description: Sorbitan monocaprylate (CAS 60177-36-8 ), also known as sorbitan caprylate, is a sorbitan ester derived from sorbitol and caprylic acid used as a non-ionic emulsifier and wetting agent across food and industrial applications. Its relatively short C8 fatty acid chain gives it an HLB profile suited to water-in-oil emulsion systems and surface modification tasks where lighter esters are preferred for specific formulation needs. In food manufacturing, it functions as an emulsifier to stabilize fat-in-water systems and improve texture consistency in processed products. It helps maintain a uniform distribution of ingredients during storage. Personal care formulators incorporate it into creams and lotions where it contributes both emulsification and moisturizing performance. This dual functionality often reduces the need for additional humectants in recipes. Industrial and home care cleaning formulations use it as a wetting agent to improve substrate penetration and surface coverage. It is highly effective at lowering surface tension in various liquid systems. In textile and leather processing, it supports surface modification during finishing stages, improving uniformity of treatment across fiber and hide substrates. This ensures a high-quality finish for the end product. Sorbitan monocaprylate is typically supplied as a liquid or low-viscosity oily substance. It is available in food-grade and technical-grade specifications depending on the target application and regulatory needs. Buyers sourcing for food or cosmetic use should confirm compliance with relevant regional purity standards before procurement.
